title: A corpus callee whose own body does not validate yields no summary: 4,909 uncontracted-call leaves on the callee's own unit
why: Card W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES classified every `call to uncontracted function` leaf of an Unknown function at base c1e69bb5 (9,547 leaves / 2,591 functions / 407 blocked only by uncontracted calls) by where the callee's body is. The callee's body is in the calling unit, inside W4's derivation scope, and does not validate for 4,909 leaves: 3,594 leaves / 1,566 callees / 219 sole-blocked where it is a selected main-source definition whose own body is Unknown, 58 / 38 / 4 where that body is provisional Unsafe, and 1,257 / 155 / 12 where it is a header `static` definition the card newly admitted to the scope whose body does not validate (378 leaves over 20 callees blocked only by further uncontracted calls, 879 over 135 by some other refusal). Among the 1,395 callees called only from their own unit, the dominant families of their own bodies are indirect access (1,146 callees), branch/loop conditions (884), further uncontracted calls (826) and unresolved identities (444); 56 of them (205 leaves) are blocked only by uncontracted calls. This is constraint 4's premise, measured on the call family: a summary requires the callee's own body to be fully modeled and defect-free, and no summary route can publish one without it. Discharge condition: none by a summary route; the leaves move as other cards model the callee bodies, and a card that does so re-measures this census (`docs/reports/w44-corpus-callee-summaries/scripts/callee_census.py`, `body_reasons.py`, `header_reasons.py`).

title: A callee defined in another pinned unit gets no summary: no cross-unit summary route (2,975 leaves; 104 with a Safe home body)
why: Card W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES measured 2,975 uncontracted-call leaves of Unknown functions whose callee has no body in the calling unit but a main-source definition in another pinned unit: 2,841 leaves / 695 callees / 36 sole-blocked where that home body is Unknown, 104 / 35 / 2 where it is Safe, 30 / 19 / 1 where it is provisional Unsafe. Only the 104 are reachable by a cross-unit route today (largest: rd_kafka_error_destroy 27, cio_error_reset 18, rd_kafka_topic_result_destroy 6, mk_string_dup 6). The top blockers of the whole family are here (rd_list_destroy 128, rd_kafka_op_destroy 103, rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_destroy 88, rd_kafka_op_new0 79, ut_destroy_metadata 77), and every one of them has an Unknown home body. A cross-unit route needs a summary validated in its home unit's environment to be applied in another unit with its identity pinned (home unit source digest and environment), a stated external-linkage resolution premise (the call binds the one external definition in the linked program), certificate re-derivation of both halves, Lean parity and a measured arbiter. Discharge condition: that route, or declared contracts for the reachable callees; the census is `docs/reports/w44-corpus-callee-summaries/census/`.

title: A header definition of external linkage is refused on linkage (86 leaves, all mpack C99 inline)
why: Card W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES admits to the W4 derivation scope only unselected definitions whose own specifiers carry `static` and not `extern`. A header definition of external linkage stays out: under C11 6.7.4p7 a call to a function with an inline definition may use the external definition instead, and an ordinary external definition may be interposed, so the body the unit analyses need not be the body the call runs. Measured: 86 leaves / 16 callees / 39 Unknown functions / 0 sole-blocked, every one an `mpack_*` function (`mpack_finish_map` 27, `mpack_finish_array` 23, `mpack_write_uint` 8, ...). The reader also answers `not established` for a definition whose `static` is spelled only on an earlier declaration (internal by C11 6.2.2p5); the census's own classifier reads the same specifiers, so any such definition is counted inside these 86 and was not separated. Discharge condition: an identity check that the external definition the link resolves to is the same text as the analysed inline definition (for example mpack.c compiled from the same header under MPACK_EMIT_INLINE_DEFS), with Lean parity; or declared contracts in the owning provider crate.

title: A callee with no body in any pinned unit can be decided only by a declaration (950 leaves; cfl_sds_cat_safe alone 170)
why: Card W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES measured 950 uncontracted-call leaves / 217 callees / 361 Unknown functions / 23 sole-blocked whose callee has no definition in the calling unit and none in any pinned unit. The largest are the cfl library, which is not a pinned unit (cfl_sds_cat_safe 170, 2 sole; cfl_sds_create_size 19; cfl_kvlist_fetch 16), compiler builtins (__builtin_va_end 55, __builtin_va_start 50, __builtin_memcpy 27, __builtin_va_arg 20), libc (vsnprintf 25), OpenSSL (X509_free 17) and mpack functions with no inline definition in the unit (mpack_start_map 27, mpack_write_nil 21, mpack_start_array 15). No summary route can reach them. Discharge condition: declared contracts in the owning provider crate (libc names only in quirin-provider-libc), builtin modeling, or adding the defining library to the pinned corpus; each re-measured with this census.

title: No releases-its-formal destructor summary is admitted for a body that is not fully modeled (230 callees, 1,175 leaves)
why: Card W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES sized the destructor-shaped callees (names reading destroy/free/release/unref/clear/term/fini/cleanup) among the same-unit and other-unit callees whose own body does not validate: 230 callees own 1,175 uncontracted-call leaves, including rd_list_destroy (128), rd_kafka_op_destroy (103) and rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_destroy (88). Only 8 of them (53 leaves) have a body blocked by uncontracted calls alone; every other one carries indirect access, a loop or branch condition, or an unresolved identity. A summary saying the body releases its formal and touches nothing else the caller tracks cannot be proved of a body with an unmodeled statement, since that statement may release, publish or retain anything, so the card declined it rather than approximate. The existing vocabulary already states a released formal (`Released`) and cascades a release through containment; what is missing is a modeled body. Discharge condition: modeling the list-walk and member-release shapes these bodies use so ordinary W4 validates `Released`, or a new summary form with a Lean proof that the unmodeled remainder cannot affect caller-tracked state, and a measured arbiter.

title: Reserved-name header bodies (__bswap_16/32/64, __uint64_identity) are held out of the widened W4 scope although they validate
why: Card W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES excludes from the widened derivation scope every name reserved in all contexts (`__x`, `_X`, C11 7.1.3), so that glibc header bodies stay with the libc provider's decision (card W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS owns __bswap_*). A census run without that filter measured that all four bodies validate `Borrowed -> None` and would decide 599 uncontracted-call leaves (586 in Unknown functions, 97 functions, 3 sole) and move ut_put_be16/32/64 (rdunittest_msgset_errors.c) Unknown -> Safe. This refines W43-LIBC-HEADER-INLINE-BODIES: its discharge condition asks for `__builtin_bswap*` modeling so W4 can derive the bodies, but the bodies already validate; only the derivation scope excluded them. Discharge condition: W44-LIBC-RESIDUALS' decision, recorded; if the bodies are to be checked rather than declared, lift the reserved filter for system-header bodies (docs/reports/w44-corpus-callee-summaries/census/prediction-unreserved.json gives the predicted delta) with a re-arbiter.
